body:
lauren.p: FYI NimbleAccel just sent an advance notice: theyre changing their gateway API (headers + payload layout). Target flip date 2026-05-15. Theyre asking marketplace images and partner integrations to be forward-compatible. Can we sketch a plan?

mike.dev: We can add a thin translation shim in our marketplace image that maps old headers/payload to the new shape. Low risk and fast.

sanjay: Two parallel tracks: 1) runtime shim in marketplace images (fast rollback), 2) upstream SDK change that tolerates both shapes. Prefer shim + optional SDK fallback flag.

taylor.pm: Partner wants a validated migration path in Q2. We need partner notice, migration guide, and SDK compatibility strategy. Can we propose dates?

anna.docs: Ill draft the migration doc and FAQ. Need exact request examples and curl snippets + expected responses. Also want a tiny test harness repo for partners to run against.

helen.nimble: From NimbleAccel: change summary  X-Accel-Version replaced by X-NA-Version; body field model_id moves under meta.model_ref. We'll keep old behavior for 90 days after flip but strongly encourage early migration. Sharing full spec link shortly.

mike.dev: Draft shim logic:
```
if (headers["X-Accel-Version"]) headers["X-NA-Version"] = headers["X-Accel-Version"];
if (body.model_id) { body.meta = body.meta||{}; body.meta.model_ref = body.model_id; delete body.model_id; }
```
We can ship as minor patch to marketplace image.

lauren.p: Partner asks for: 1) marketplace compatibility guarantee, 2) SDK deprecation timeline, 3) migration docs + tests. Ill own partner comms.

taylor.pm: Proposed dates:
- 2026-03-30: partner notice + internal heads-up
- 2026-04-08: shim landed in marketplace canary + QA
- 2026-04-18: migration guide + test harness published
- 2026-04-22: SDK patch release (opt-in fallback)
- 2026-05-15: NimbleAccel flips default; we keep shim for 90 days
- 2026-08-13: shim deprecated (90 days after flip)
Does that work?

sanjay: Dates look doable. I'll open a rollout ticket and loop in eng-infra + eng-sre for canary policy.

anna.docs: Please paste spec snippet when available so I can add example requests.

helen.nimble: Spec uploaded: https://nimble/partner-spec/v2  includes header/payload diffs and test vectors.

mike.dev: CI plan: add contract test that sends old payload and asserts new endpoint accepts it. Add to partner-integ pipeline and marketplace image build.

lauren.p: Action items:
- lauren.p: send partner notice by 2026-03-30
- sanjay: create rollout ticket + infra checklist by 2026-03-31 (owns shim deploy)
- mike.dev: implement shim + unit tests by 2026-04-08; add contract test by 2026-04-10
- anna.docs: draft migration guide + curl examples + test harness README by 2026-04-18
- taylor.pm: coordinate marketplace listing + partner announcement by 2026-04-25

mike.dev: Also adding env var REDWOOD_NA_COMPAT=true in SDKs to enable fallback for those who can't migrate immediately. We'll release as patch and mark deprecated after 45 days.

helen.nimble: That fallback approach is acceptable for enterprise customers. We'll advise migration.

anna.docs: Example snippet Ill include:
```bash
# old
curl -H "X-Accel-Version: 1" -d '{"model_id":"rwd-1","input":"hello"}' https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# new
curl -H "X-NA-Version: 1" -d '{"meta":{"model_ref":"rwd-1"},"input":"hello"}' https://inference.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```

mike.dev: Canary plan: 5% traffic to shim image in staging -> 10% limited marketplace -> full after 48h no regressions. Add latency probes and error thresholds.

lauren.p: Partner blurb I'll send: "Redwood will provide a compatibility gateway in marketplace images to bridge NimbleAccel's v1->v2 gateway change. See migration guide and test harness for details."

deploy-bot: marketplace-image/compat-shim deployed to canary (sha: ef34b7a) at 2026-04-08T14:12:05Z :rocket:

mike.dev: PR #3580 open with shim + tests. Request reviews from @sanjay and @anna.docs for test vectors.

sanjay: Reviewing; adding perf guard to ensure shim adds <5ms p50.

anna.docs: Ill sync test vectors from Nimble spec and update docs once CI is green.

lauren.p: Thanks all  once PR merges Ill send the partner notice and schedule. :thumbsup:
